newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore NTUC to lower policy loan interest rates.
newsitem.headline: Singapore NTUC to lower policy loan interest rates.

text.p: NTUC Income, one of Singapore's largest composite insurers, said on Saturday it will reduce the interest rate on policy loans by 0.5 percent to 6.5 percent per annum on August 1, ahead of bonus cuts next year.
"Interest rates have generally come down so we are taking the opportunity to be fair to the policy holders," Chief Executive Officer Tan Kin Lian told Reuters.

As of July 1, NTUC Income, which loans up to 95 percent of the cash value of the insurance policy, granted Singapore $140 million to around 40,000 policyholders. The reduction in the rates represents a total saving of $700,000 for policyholders, Tan said.
The cut will bring NTUC Income's interest rate down to one of the lowest in the industry in Singapore with most other life insurers charging 7.0 to 8.0 percent.
Tan also said the drop in interest rates is ahead of a cut in bonus rates.
He said the current bonus rates, generally close to 6.0 percent per annum, will be reduced by 1.0 percent.
